title: chrysanthemum purpureiflorum
intro: Chrysanthemum purpureiflorum, commonly known as the Purple Chrysanthemum or Qī Huá Jué, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve fever, and promote sweating, which can help to treat conditions such as the common cold and flu. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum purpureiflorum include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve respiratory issues and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, such as quercetin, kaempferol, and chrysosplenol-D, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
